what: Remove Extra Spaces cleans up the spacing in any text. It turns double spaces into single ones, trims the start and end of lines, removes or merges empty lines, joins lines that were broken in the wrong places, turns tabs into spaces and removes invisible characters.

It is made for anyone who copies text between programs: students pasting from PDFs, office workers cleaning emails, writers tidying drafts, and developers fixing data before importing it. The clean text appears instantly as you type or change an option.
All processing happens in your browser, so your text is not uploaded.
uses: Join lines that break in the middle of sentences while keeping real paragraphs.
Remove stray spaces and invisible characters that stop lookups and formulas from matching.
Remove double spaces and long gaps of empty lines.
Join a column of items into one line separated by commas or another separator.
Turn tabs into spaces with proper tab stops.
tutorial: Put your text in Your text, or press Try an example to see how it works.
Trim spaces removes spaces at the start and end of each line. Turn double spaces into one collapses gaps between words.
Turn several empty lines into one keeps paragraphs but removes big gaps. Remove all empty lines deletes every blank line.
Tick Join lines, then choose what goes between the lines: a space, nothing, a comma or your own separator. Keep paragraphs joins only the lines inside each paragraph.
Change tabs to spaces uses the tab width you pick. Fix invisible and odd spaces replaces non-breaking spaces and removes zero-width characters.
Check the counters for how many characters were removed, then click Copy clean text or Download .txt.
features: The clean text updates as you type or tick an option.
Join lines with any separator and keep paragraphs apart.
Removes zero-width spaces and byte-order marks while keeping joiners that emoji and many languages need.
Tabs become spaces that keep columns aligned.
Optionally remove spaces before commas, full stops and question marks, including Arabic-script and East Asian punctuation.
Works on documents with hundreds of thousands of lines.
Your text never leaves your device.

example.title: Worked example: cleaning text from a PDF
example.text: You paste: "This   text was copied from / a PDF, so the lines / break in odd places." (three lines) followed by three empty lines and another paragraph. With the default options, double spaces become single and the three empty lines become one. Tick Join lines with a space and Keep paragraphs: the first paragraph becomes one sentence on one line, the second paragraph stays separate. Copy clean text to use it.

tips: Leave Trim spaces off for code or poems where the indentation at the start of a line matters.
Use Join lines with comma and space to turn a column of names into a single line.
Untick Keep paragraphs to put everything on one line.
If a search or formula in a spreadsheet fails on text that looks right, run it through here with Fix invisible and odd spaces on.
French typography puts a space before ! and ?; leave Remove spaces before punctuation off for French text.
problems: Untick Trim spaces at the start and end of each line. With trimming off, spaces at the start of a line are kept.
Make sure Keep paragraphs is ticked and Remove all empty lines is off, because paragraphs are found by the empty lines between them.
Your text may already be clean. Compare the Characters before and Characters after counters.
